List available glyhub datasets

Source: R/load.R
glyhub_catalog.Rd

List externally hosted datasets without downloading any files. All data are stored in a versioned GitHub Release and excluded from the package.

Usage

glyhub_catalog(kind = c("curated", "raw", "all"))

Arguments

kind

List "curated" datasets (default), "raw" source archives, or "all" resources. Raw archives are currently available for CPTAC only.

Value

A data frame containing dataset identifiers, source, file format, storage, compressed bytes, SHA-256, version, URL and dimensions.

Examples

glyhub_catalog()[, c("dataset", "storage", "bytes")]
